en: Black‑and‑white postcard view overlooking a coastal town with flat-roofed white buildings beside the sea. On the right foreground stands a traditional round stone windmill with a thatched conical roof and radiating spars, characteristic of the Cyclades. The sea and distant land are visible in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the scene as Mykonos and describe it as a partial view.
